components.purpose: Opening banner — a hero component with a built-in 'Personalization' tab (nested PersonalizedHeroItem list keyed by audienceText), so its heading/description/CTAs adapt to the visitor's detected industry/audience.
Logo row — pulls from the shared Customers list and shows personalized logos per audience (via the CustomerProfile model's Audience field), so the logos shown adapt to the visitor's industry.
Feature cards section that follows — displays a heading/subheading plus a grid of cards (BentoCard: eyebrow, title, description, graphic), used here as the page's feature cards.
